title: The status screen's 'Hollows rested: X/8' counter climbs for bargained hollows too (it read 3/8 after exactly three bargains and zero true-rest resolutions), while in-fiction companion dialogue draws a sharp line between the two ('Bargained, not burned, not rested outright' — Lys). The counter turned out to satisfy the 'three hollows rested' Coldpass gate even though none of the three were 'rested' in the sense the prose uses, which wasn't stated anywhere before I tested it at the Pass Gate.
where: status screen 'Hollows rested' line vs. Lys's line at The Sworn Glade after the Thornwold bargain
